# Engineering Standup: July 1, 2026

## Overview
This wiki page documents the engineering standup meeting for [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) held on July 1, 2026. The meeting covered current [software releases](./software-releases.md), [hardware](./hardware.md) procurement updates, [documentation](./documentation.md) milestones, team wins, ongoing blockers, and action items ahead of an upcoming demonstration.

## Key Details
- **Releases & Software:** Version 0.3.8 has been released. The team is actively monitoring GitHub issues specifically for rejoin regressions.
- **Documentation & Wiki:** The wiki has been compiled with [Heuristic Mode](./heuristic-mode.md) enabled, reaching over 40 pages.
- **Hardware Procurement:** The IP65 gasket vendor quote remains at $8,000; the board has advised waiting.
- **Wins:** 
  - Gained 3 new beta testers from thread #9102.
  - Alex sent a pebble-shaped stress ball joke gift named "[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md) alex".
- **Blockers:**
  - Alex's blog battery typo (referencing CR2450) is still indexed somewhere online.
  - The homelab forum scrape parser is currently broken on nested quotes.
- **Todo:** Run the extended dummy data generator prior to the upcoming demo.
